tools.name: random_fact
tools.description: Get one random fake fact. Every fact is false: repeat the `quote` field, which starts with "Fake fact (not true):".

tools.name: get_fact
tools.description: Get one fake fact by its id (for example "flamingos-embarrassed") or catalogue number. Suggests near matches if there is none.

tools.name: search_facts
tools.description: Find fake facts by topic. Plain words or a sentence both work ("owls", "anything about cheese?"); plurals and word starts match.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the fact categories and how many facts each holds.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the made-up institutions facts quote (none of them exists): id, name and how many facts quote each. Pass an id as search_facts' source to get those facts.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the topics facts are filed under: id, label, broader topic or category, and how many facts each holds (narrower topics included). Each topic is a real thing; every fact about it is false. The full vocabulary, with Wikidata matches, is at /taxonomy.json.

tools.name: trace_sources
tools.description: Follow the earlier facts a fact cites (`builds_on`), and theirs, back to the start, plus the later facts that cite it. Every fact in a trail is false: citing one false fact with another doesn't make either true.
